items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: He used to play there too. And I used to come there and play there too at Judge Ben Mulligan on Grab and Rampart.

ctx.x: What was your first job? Do you remember when that first job?

The first job I played was at this, was at, let's see, by Ben Mulligan for the George. Well that was for George, Joan and, well, Horst was there, but we used to call him Manuel Minetta. He used to play there too. And I used to come there and play there too at Judge Ben Mulligan on Grab and Rampart. They used to have the judge and all we used to entertain the judge. And then, you know, late watchmen. Was that near the Palm Garden?
Where was, it was just the saloon, was it?
